categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the oil and gas drilling specialized tools and equipment manufacturing and services industry. Main business segments include: (1) Drilling tools products - primarily screw drilling motors and related downhole tools; (2) Equipment products - mainly wellhead equipment and drilling equipment; (3) Rental and maintenance services for drilling tools; and (4) Engineering technical services including directional drilling and horizontal drilling services. The company serves the petroleum, natural gas, shale gas, coalbed methane, and geothermal drilling sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on screw drilling motor (downhole power drilling tool) design and manufacturing, with advanced capabilities in large torque transmission technology, horizontal well stabilization technology, expandable screw drilling tool technology, and radial bearing manufacturing. Production methods include precision machining of complex components, specialized rubber formulation for motor stators, and integrated assembly of drilling tools. The company utilizes advanced CNC equipment and has established complete quality control systems including API certification compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are major Chinese state-owned oil and gas companies including China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), China Petrochemical Corporation (Sinopec), China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC), and Shaanxi延长 Petroleum, along with their subsidiary drilling and engineering service companies. The company also serves private oil and gas engineering service companies domestically and international customers in North America, Middle East, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and Russia. End markets include onshore and offshore oil and gas exploration and development, shale gas/oil development, and coalbed methane extraction.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Dezhou, Shandong Province. Domestically, it maintains sales and service presence in major oil-producing regions including Xinjiang, Sichuan, Gansu, Shaanxi, Inner Mongolia, and the Bohai Bay offshore region. Internationally, the company has established operations and partnerships in Russia (with subsidiary Lianhe Petroleum Technology Service Ltd.), the United States (through IAE International Inc. acquisition), and serves customers across the Middle East, Central Asia, and Southeast Asia. The company has service bases in Xinjiang, Sichuan, Gansu, Shaanxi, and other key regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the oil and gas supply chain. It manufactures specialized drilling tools and equipment used during the exploration and development phase of oil and gas extraction. The company sources raw materials and components from suppliers, manufactures finished drilling tools and equipment, and provides these products and services directly to oil and gas exploration and production companies and drilling service contractors. The company also provides rental services for its drilling tools, positioning it as both a manufacturer and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic R&D focus includes: (1) Development of high-temperature screw drilling motors (targeting 200°C and above); (2) Advanced drilling tool systems including near-bit steering tools and rotary steerable systems; (3) High-pressure wellhead equipment (140MPa and above); (4) Specialized drilling tools for complex wells including extended reach horizontal wells; (5) Intelligent drilling systems and measurement-while-drilling technologies; (6) Non-conventional drilling applications including mining and directional crossing. The company emphasizes continuous innovation in materials science, particularly rubber formulations and bearing manufacturing, and maintains active collaboration with research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) Direct product sales of drilling tools and equipment to oil and gas companies and drilling contractors; (2) Equipment rental services where drilling tools are leased to customers on an hourly or usage basis with revenue recognized based on actual usage reported by customers; (3) Maintenance and repair services for drilling equipment; (4) Engineering technical services for directional drilling, horizontal drilling, and specialized drilling projects where revenue is recognized based on completed work and customer confirmation. The company primarily operates on a direct sales model with long-term relationships with major customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of China's leading screw drilling motor manufacturers with significant market share in the domestic market, ranking among the top competitors. The company competes with both domestic manufacturers and international drilling tool suppliers. Key competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, established customer relationships with major state-owned oil companies, comprehensive product portfolio, and integrated product-plus-service business model. The company faces competition from other specialized drilling equipment manufacturers and international suppliers, but maintains differentiation through technical innovation and customer service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized oil and gas equipment manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 667.2 million yuan, representing 17.68% growth compared to 2023 revenue of 567.0 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 99.2 million yuan in 2024, up 14.37% from 86.7 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 1.78 billion yuan at year-end 2024, up 9.5% from 1.63 billion yuan in 2023. The company demonstrates consistent growth trajectory with improving profitability and strong cash generation (operating cash flow of 197.1 million yuan in 2024, up 86.13% year-over-year). The company has 829 employees and maintains healthy financial metrics with ROE of 7.56%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on providing high-performance, reliable drilling tools and equipment specifically engineered for China's complex and challenging oil and gas exploration environments. Key differentiators include: (1) Customized product design capabilities to meet specific geological and operational requirements of different oil fields; (2) Advanced screw motor technology enabling higher torque, efficiency, and reliability in demanding conditions; (3) Integrated product-plus-service model providing comprehensive drilling solutions; (4) Strong technical support and field service capabilities; (5) Compliance with international standards (API certification) ensuring quality and reliability; (6) Continuous innovation in high-temperature, high-pressure, and specialized drilling applications. The company emphasizes quality, reliability, and customer-centric technical innovation as core competitive advantages.
